findings.title: Revalidate planned fixes when the target checkout changes
findings.description: The second readiness check verifies cleanliness, not that files or HEAD still match the dry run. During the confirmation prompt, another agent can commit changes or switch branches, leaving a clean checkout. The old findings are then applied and committed automatically. Because `updateCheckbox` uses the saved line number without verifying the entry identity, this can update the wrong checkbox. Record and validate the checked snapshot, or regenerate findings before applying. Add coverage for a clean committed change between planning and application.

findings.title: Git probe failures are misreported as checkout states
findings.description: Both catches classify every failure as an expected state. A timeout, permission error, or unavailable Git executable becomes `NOT_A_CHECKOUT` or `DETACHED_HEAD`, hiding the actual failure behind misleading deferral text. Preserve structured Git error information, handle only the expected exit statuses, and propagate or explicitly report other failures. Add tests for unexpected probe failures.
